#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ build_event_invitation.py Creates a secure, sanitized HTML invitation from user supplied data. """ import html from string import Template # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for the event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ $event_title

$event_title

Date: $event_date

Description

$event_description

$additional_notes_block
""" def build_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, details_of_event: str, when_event_is: str, extra_event_info: str ) -> str: """ Produce a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The heading of the event. details_of_event : str A detailed description (may contain newlines or user‑generated content). when_event_is : str The scheduled date of the event. extra_event_info : str Any supplementary notes or instructions. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized HTML string ready for rendering in a browser. Raises ------ ValueError If any required argument is missing or not a string. """ # Validate inputs are strings for name, value in [ ("title_of_event", title_of_event), ("details_of_event", details_of_event), ("when_event_is", when_event_is), ("extra_event_info", extra_event_info) ]: if not isinstance(value, str): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a string") # Escape user supplied content to neutralise XSS vectors safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(details_of_event, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(when_event_is, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_event_info, quote=False).replace("\n", "
") # Prepare the additional notes block only if there is content if safe_notes.strip(): notes_block = f"""

Additional Notes

{safe_notes}

""" else: notes_block = "" # Create a Template instance and substitute placeholders tmpl = Template(INVITATION_FORMAT) sanitized_html = tmpl.substitute( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes_block=notes_block ) return sanitized_html # Example usage (remove or comment out in production) if __name__ == "__main__": print(build_event_invitation( title_of_event="Annual Gala & Celebration", details_of_event="Join us for an evening of fun, food, and festivities.\nDon't miss the live DJ!", when_event_is="2026-12-31", extra_event_info="Dress code: Formal attire.\nParking available on site." ))
